target_interpretation.canonical_governance_statement: The observed out-of-sample coverage point estimate (95.02%) met the preregistered 95.00% target in the tested evaluation population. However, because the 95% Wilson confidence interval [93.09%, 96.43%] includes values below 95.00%, the release does not claim a statistical guarantee of 95% coverage across all operational warehouse populations.
target_interpretation.prohibited_claim_statement: Do not claim '95% coverage has been statistically proven or guaranteed'.
